columns.comment: Liquidity-need event id.

columns.comment: Predicted Shortfall or Predicted Surplus.
columns.name: event_type

columns.comment: dim_client version valid on the event date (as-was, D11) - its primary RM is the RM of the event.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Core-banking customer number (source identity record) of the client.

columns.comment: Client's coverage office / booking location (ISO-2).
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Forecast model that flagged the event (v1 or v2).
columns.name: model_version

columns.comment: Run date of the forecast behind the event.
columns.name: forecast_run_date

columns.comment: Target month of that forecast.
columns.name: forecast_target_month

columns.comment: Days from the forecast run to the event date.
columns.name: horizon_days

columns.comment: Forecast horizon of the model behind the event (30D = one month ahead).
columns.name: horizon_label

columns.comment: Forecast inflows of the target month, USD (null for scripted HK surplus events).
columns.name: forecast_inflows_usd

columns.name: predicted_amount_usd

columns.name: severity_ratio

columns.comment: True when the client has a committed revolving credit facility.

columns.name: action_taken

columns.name: action_product_id

columns.comment: Date of the RCF drawdown / TD placement (null when none).
columns.name: action_date

columns.comment: Days from the event to the action (null when none). Average Days to Action = AVG over actioned events.
columns.name: days_to_action

columns.comment: Amount drawn / placed, USD.
columns.name: action_amount_usd

columns.comment: RCF facility drawn (RCF Drawdown events).

columns.comment: Amount of the linked drawdown in the loan schedule, USD.
columns.name: linked_drawdown_usd

columns.comment: Estimated annual revenue of the action (RCF margin or TD spread on the amount), USD - Revenue from Actions.

columns.name: event_status

columns.comment: True when an action followed (Actioned %).
columns.name: is_actioned

columns.comment: True for shortfalls followed by an RCF drawdown within 10 days (dim_threshold RCF_FOLLOW_UP_DAYS) linked in the loan schedule.
columns.name: is_rcf_drawdown_within_10d

columns.comment: True for predicted surpluses above USD 20m (dim_threshold SURPLUS_ATTENTION_USD).
columns.name: is_large_surplus

columns.comment: True for predicted surpluses where no TD was placed (deposit / investment opportunity).
columns.name: is_surplus_not_placed

comment: Liquidity-need events flagged by the cash-flow forecasts (Jul-2024 to Sep-2026): predicted shortfalls (forecast inflows below the expected outflows) and predicted surpluses, with the forecast behind them (model version, run date, horizon, inflows, outflows, net, severity vs the client's typical gross flow), the client's undrawn RCF headroom, and what happened next - RCF drawdown (linked to the drawdown in the loan schedule), TD placed or none - with the action date, days to action, amount and estimated annual revenue. Storyline 9: exactly 23 predicted shortfalls Jun-Sep 2026, 15 of them followed by an RCF drawdown within 10 days (is_rcf_drawdown_within_10d). Amounts are per event (additive across events). Grain: one row per liquidity-need event (event_id).
